questions.prompt: What is the correct arithmetic mean (sum divided by count) of the values [1, 3, 8]?
questions.explanation: Sum = 1 + 3 + 8 = 12, count = 3, so mean = 12 / 3 = 4. (The median is 3, which is not the mean.)

questions.prompt: A test suite has 3 test cases, and exactly 1 of them fails. How many test cases pass?
questions.explanation: Every case either passes or fails: passing = total − failing = 3 − 1 = 2.
